sources_read: canonical Daniel coordinates and WEB text
independently selected canonical-66 passages listed here

chunks.form: court-entry narrative: siege frame, selected youths, training, and renaming
chunks.marker: The siege/vessel opening moves through royal selection and imposed names; Dan.1.8 begins a new volitional test.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate siege chronology or atomize names/training lists.
chunks.risk: Chronology, temple vessels, name etymology, identity, and exile harmonization remain unresolved.

chunks.form: court test: refusal request, negotiated ten-day trial, and result
chunks.marker: Daniel's resolve initiates a bounded negotiation that closes when the steward replaces the royal provisions.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach Dan.1.8 or the food list as a universal dietary rule.
chunks.risk: Defilement rationale, food terms, ethics, miracle/providence, and application remain undecided.

chunks.form: court evaluation and horizon notice
chunks.marker: The four receive learning, are examined, and enter royal service; Dan.1.21 extends Daniel's service horizon.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate ten-times language or the Cyrus notice as chronology/superiority proof.
chunks.risk: Chronology, inspiration, court office, scope of the Cyrus notice, and historicity remain held.

chunks.form: royal dream crisis and death decree
chunks.marker: The troubled king demands dream and interpretation, rejects the specialists' protest, and issues a decree reaching Daniel.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not use Dan.2.4b's language switch as automatic source/authorship boundary or split specialist lists.
chunks.risk: Hebrew-Aramaic switch, demand wording, court categories, violence, chronology, and history remain held.

chunks.form: wise response, communal petition, revelation, and hymn
chunks.marker: Daniel seeks time, gathers companions, receives the secret, and gives one complete praise response.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the hymn from crisis, petition, and response.
chunks.risk: Prayer theology, revelation, miracle/historicity, and liturgical reuse remain undecided.

chunks.form: court re-entry and interpretation preface
chunks.marker: Daniel halts execution, enters the audience, rejects human-wisdom credit, and frames the disclosure.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate Dan.2.28 as an end-time proof text.
chunks.risk: Latter-days language, revelation, prediction, fulfillment, and divine knowledge are deferred.

chunks.form: image dream report with point-by-point interpretation
chunks.marker: The image is reported in Dan.2.31-35; This is the dream introduces an interpretation repeating the same materials and closing the pair.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach image parts, kingdoms, stone, Dan.2.44, or individual metals.
chunks.risk: Kingdom/stone identities, sequence, chronology, fulfillment, eschatology, and theology remain unresolved.

chunks.form: royal response, promotion, and companion appointments
chunks.marker: The king responds after interpretation, confers office, and Daniel requests companion appointments; Dan.3.1 resets.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate worship language or each office as doctrine/history.
chunks.risk: Gesture, worship/offering terms, administration, chronology, and chapter-3 relation are held.

chunks.form: image dedication, decree, instrument refrain, and compliance
chunks.marker: A new image gathers officials; the herald's command and repeated instruments culminate in public prostration.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize officials, instruments, nations, or refrain occurrences.
chunks.risk: Image identity, measurements, instrument translation/loanwords, worship, and historical setting are deferred.

chunks.form: accusation, royal interrogation, and three-person answer
chunks.marker: Accusers restate the decree and provoke an ultimatum answered by the complete refusal statement.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate Dan.3.17-18 as generalized proof text.
chunks.risk: Accuser identity, confession/application, deliverance claim, ethics, martyrdom reception, and history are held.

chunks.form: furnace peril, fourth figure, summons, and inspected deliverance
chunks.marker: Punishment escalates; the three are cast in, a fourth is observed, and officials inspect the unharmed men after exit.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the fourth figure, Dan.3.25, or fire inventory from the full scene.
chunks.risk: Fourth-figure/angel identity, translation, miracle, historicity, and typology remain non-authorized.

chunks.form: royal blessing, coercive decree, and promotion coda
chunks.marker: Nebuchadnezzar interprets the event, issues a new decree, and the narrator closes with promotion.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach blessing from its violent decree or promotion from the tale.
chunks.risk: Royal confession, coercion, violence, angel identity, empire policy, ethics, and theology remain deferred.

chunks.form: royal proclamation salutation and hymnic thesis
chunks.marker: Formal addressees and peace introduce purpose and compact praise before first-person narrative at Dan.4.4.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate individual kingdom phrases.
chunks.risk: Proclamation genre, editorial frame, confession, empire scope, theology, and relation to Dan.3 are held.

chunks.form: first-person dream crisis and tree/watcher report
chunks.marker: The king recounts fear, failed specialists, Daniel's arrival, and the complete tree/watcher dream ending in a request.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach tree, watcher decree, seven times, or specialist list.
chunks.risk: Watcher terms, seven-times calculation, symbolism, diagnosis, source strata, and identity remain deferred.

chunks.form: Daniel's troubled interpretation and counsel
chunks.marker: Daniel's silence and reassurance introduce point-by-point interpretation followed by direct counsel.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not sever counsel from dream interpretation or use it to settle doctrine/diagnosis.
chunks.risk: Righteousness/mercy wording, divine decree, mental state, chronology, ethics, and theology are held.

chunks.form: dream realization, abasement, restoration, and doxology
chunks.marker: All this came initiates realization; first-person royal voice returns after recovery and closes with praise.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate heavenly voice, beast-like condition, or doxology.
chunks.risk: Historicity, diagnosis, miracle, time period, judgment, conversion, ethics, and theology remain undecided.

chunks.form: feast desecration, writing apparition, failed interpreters, and queen's recommendation
chunks.marker: Vessel use triggers writing; failed specialists and fear culminate when the queen identifies Daniel.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate vessels, hand, specialists, or queen from the crisis.
chunks.risk: Kinship terms, queen identity, vessels, miracle, court offices, chronology, and history are held.

chunks.form: royal offer, Daniel's indictment, inscription, and interpretation
chunks.marker: Daniel is summoned, recalls Nebuchadnezzar, indicts Belshazzar, cites the words, and interprets them as one answer.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize MENE/TEKEL/PERES or detach interpretation from indictment.
chunks.risk: Aramaic wordplay, forms, translation, Medes/Persians, kinship, identities, and judgment are deferred.

chunks.form: investiture, royal death, and kingdom-transition coda
chunks.marker: Promised honor is conferred, Belshazzar is slain, and Darius receives the kingdom before a new administration.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not let chaptering conceal the versification seam or isolate Dan.5.31 as identity claim.
chunks.risk: Dan.5.31/Dan.6.1 numbering, Darius identity, transition, chronology, and history require review.

chunks.form: administrative elevation, conspiracy, and decree
chunks.marker: A new administration elevates Daniel; rivals devise a petition trap and obtain the king's signature.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize official counts or infer legal history from the decree formula.
chunks.risk: Titles/counts, Medo-Persian law, Darius identity, worship terms, history, and ethics are held.

chunks.form: continued prayer, discovery, accusation, failed rescue, and sealed den
chunks.marker: The decree prompts established prayer; conspirators accuse, the king fails to rescue, and the sealed den closes the night.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate Dan.6.10 as universal prescription or detach den from the legal trap.
chunks.risk: Prayer/application, Jerusalem orientation, law, sealing, miracle expectation, ethics, and history are deferred.

chunks.form: morning inquiry, deliverance, retaliatory judgment, decree, and coda
chunks.marker: The king returns, Daniel reports deliverance, outcomes reverse onto accusers, and decree/prosperity close the tale.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach angel/lions, family violence, or royal hymn from the resolution.
chunks.risk: Angel identity, miracle/history, collective punishment, confession, Cyrus chronology, ethics, and theology are held.

chunks.form: dated night vision: beasts, horn, heavenly court, and human-like figure
chunks.marker: Repeated I saw/I watched sequences culminate in court and cloud-borne figure before distress and interpretation request.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize beasts, horns, court figures, or Dan.7.13-14.
chunks.risk: All identities, service/worship, chronology, fulfillment, Christology, eschatology, and theology are deferred.

chunks.form: vision distress, interpreting dialogue, focused question, expanded answer, and closure
chunks.marker: Daniel requests truth, receives summary, asks about the fourth beast/horn, and receives expansion ending Here is the end.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split each kingdom, horn, time formula, judgment, or saints statement.
chunks.risk: Identities, saints, kingdom transfer, time-times-half, fulfillment, persecution, eschatology, and theology are held.

chunks.form: dated ram-goat vision, little horn, sanctuary pressure, and duration question
chunks.marker: A new date/location begins a continuous animal/horn sequence; holy dialogue asks and answers how long.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate horns, continual offering, desolation, or 2300 evenings-mornings for calculation.
chunks.risk: Referents, sanctuary history, translation, numbers, chronology, fulfillment, and variants are deferred.

chunks.form: angel-mediated interpretation, sealing command, and bodily aftermath
chunks.marker: Daniel seeks understanding; Gabriel interprets, commands sealing, and Daniel records illness/return to business.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach named kingdoms, fierce king, end language, sealing, or reaction.
chunks.risk: Figure identities, mappings, referent, end chronology, fulfillment, miracle, and theology are held.

chunks.form: dated reading-and-prayer setting
chunks.marker: A regnal superscription locates Daniel's reading of Jeremiah and turns to fasting, confession, and petition.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate seventy years for chronology or force harmonization.
chunks.risk: Darius identity, reckoning, Jeremiah textual form, chronology, fulfillment, authorship/date, and direction are deferred.

chunks.form: communal confession and restoration petition
chunks.marker: Covenant address moves through corporate confession and Torah-prophet reflection to an urgent city/sanctuary plea.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach confession, Mosaic curse, exodus memory, or sanctuary plea.
chunks.risk: Covenant theology, corporate guilt, intertexts, judgment, restoration, liturgy, and application remain held.

chunks.form: prayer-time angelic arrival and seventy-weeks disclosure
chunks.marker: While Daniel prays, Gabriel arrives, commissions understanding, and gives one interdependent numbered disclosure.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split weeks, anointed/prince clauses, covenant, sacrifice cessation, or abomination into calculations.
chunks.risk: Witnesses, punctuation, antecedents, actors, arithmetic, decrees, dates, fulfillment, Christology, eschatology, theology are held.

chunks.form: final revelation prologue: mourning, river vision, strengthening, messenger conflict, and bridge
chunks.marker: A date introduces mourning, luminous figure, strengthening, delay/conflict, and Dan.11.1 before Now I will show at Dan.11.2.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split by chapter or isolate angelic-prince identities.
chunks.risk: Speaker shifts, identities, angelology, conflict, chronology, miracle, history, and theology are deferred.

chunks.form: messenger disclosure: successions, north-south conflicts, alliances, and invasions
chunks.marker: Now I will show opens a sequence; repeated stand up/in his place clauses continue through Dan.11.20.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not make every ruler, marriage, campaign, place, or succession formula a chunk.
chunks.risk: All identities, geography, translation, chronology, date/authorship, history, and fulfillment remain held.

chunks.form: contemptible-ruler sequence: intrigue, campaigns, sanctuary attack, and suffering wise
chunks.marker: In his place a contemptible person begins a focused portrait through covenant/sanctuary attack and appointed-time notice.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach abomination, continual, covenant, people-who-know, or suffering-wise clauses.
chunks.risk: Ruler, covenant, Kittim, sanctuary, abomination, resistance ethics, history, fulfillment, theology are deferred.

chunks.form: self-exalting king tableau, end conflict, invasion, and unsupported end
chunks.marker: The king will do according to his will begins a potentially new/intensified portrait ending with no helper.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not force continuity/discontinuity or identify the king, gods, lands, or events.
chunks.risk: Referent continuity, actors, wording, geography, identity, chronology, fulfillment, eschatology, theology are hardest unresolved issues.

chunks.form: culminating disclosure: crisis, deliverance, awakening, wise, and sealing
chunks.marker: At that time links backward; deliverance and awakening lead directly to the command to seal the words.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate Dan.12.2-3 to decide resurrection, afterlife, fulfillment, or system.
chunks.risk: Michael, book, scope, translation of many, resurrection, outcomes, wisdom, sealing, eschatology remain held.

chunks.form: riverbank closing dialogue: questions, oath, time formulas, beatitude, and dismissal
chunks.marker: Two riverbank questions receive oath, refusal, numbered periods, and the final command to go, rest, and stand.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize time-times-half, 1290, 1335, purification, rest, or standing.
chunks.risk: Identities, variants, number relations, calculation, fulfillment, resurrection, inheritance, eschatology, theology are deferred.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Chapter fallback survives under literary labels.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Divide at scene/speech/dream-interpretation/prayer-answer/decree-coda/vision-dialogue seams and cross Dan.10.1-Dan.11.1.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Dream/vision is detached from interpretation and proof-texted.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve report-interpretation parents or paired units; select no symbol identity.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Language switch or wordplay becomes source/authorship/date authority.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Language evidence corroborates form only; roots are not meanings.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: MT/OG/Theodotion/Qumran preference or Greek-addition canon inference.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Stay in received 66-book coordinates without preferred witness, reading, or canon judgment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Ruler, kingdom, horn, prince, messenger, human-like figure, or event is fixed.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep all identities, history, chronology, fulfillment, and doctrine LOW/deferred.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Weeks/days/time formula is detached and calculated.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain numbered disclosures in full messenger/dialogue units; authorize no calculation.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Miracle, violence, coercion, or ethics fragments the tale.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve peril-deliverance-decree context; queue miracle/history/ethics separately.
Treat lists as cumulative narrative/vision registers.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Tradition-specific verse placement is mistaken for a seam.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Record Dan.5.29-Dan.6.3 alternative and prefer no versification tradition.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Final revelation becomes chapter fallback or event atoms.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain one macro parent and five meso movements including a cross-chapter prologue.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Same ruler versus pivot/recast yields incompatible outlines.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: retain alternatives; LOW; identify no ruler or fulfillment

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: At that time links strongly while deliverance/awakening forms a culmination.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: split meso units; preserve Dan.11.36-Dan.12.4 alternative

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Commission and numbered speech are distinct forms but one answer.
Versification differs and Darius transition serves coda and setup.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: record Dan.5.29-Dan.6.3 alternative; prefer no witness

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Same messenger speech crosses chapter; fresh disclosure begins Dan.11.2.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: cross chapter and end prologue at Dan.11.1

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Report and interpretation are distinct but mutually constraining.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: keep Dan.2 together; split Dan.7 with chapter parent

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Language transition is intra-verse and not representable in verse-only coordinates.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: record pressure; invent no partial verse/source claim

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Sealing closes disclosure; riverbank questions reopen it.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: split visual scene; preserve full final-revelation parent
